test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

EXULTATION
solution:
The correct answer is '**Jubilation**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Exultation**' is '**Jubilation**'.
 
• **Exultation**: a feeling of triumphant elation or jubilation; rejoicing. (विजयी अभिलाषा या उल्लास की भावना; आनन्द)
 
 
• *Example: She laughs in **exultation**.*
 
 
 
• **Jubilation**: great happiness because of a success. (सफलता प्राप्ति पर) हर्षोल्लास, आनंदोत्‍सव
 
 
• *Example: There was much **jubilation** among the garrison at this outcome of the long-expected and dreaded attack.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Jubilation.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Depression**: a feeling of unhappiness that lasts for a long time. Depression can be a medical condition and may have physical signs, for example being unable to sleep, etc.. विषाद का भाव, अवसाद (यह देर तक रहता है और कभी-कभी अनिद्रा आदि के रूप में प्रकट होता है) 
 
• **Agitation**: a state of anxiety or nervous excitement. (चिंता या घबराहट की स्थिति)
 
• **Irritation**: the state of feeling annoyed, impatient, or slightly angry. (नाराज़, अधीर, या थोड़ा गुस्सा महसूस करने की स्थिति)
